Customer provides full 17-character VIN — agent accepts it without asking the customer to repeat just the last 8 characters, then calls get_contract_and_claims_data_ivr with the VIN — that lookup fails. Agent reads back the VIN and asks the customer to correct it or provide a different identifier. Customer provides claim number. e2e_rf_identifier_loop_agent_transfer

Repair facility calls to update a claim and requests an agent — two consecutive identifier lookups fail (VIN then claim number) — agent should transfer to a live agent rather than ending the call. Also validates agent does NOT ask for VIN a second time after it already failed. Reproduces production issues from conv 0700046509. Same identifier-loop fix applies to DealershipIssues (tested separately).

Scenario Overview

Customer Goals
  • When the agent asks your caller type, say you are an independent repair facility
  • Tell the agent you need to speak to an agent about updating a claim
  • When the agent asks for an identifier, provide the last 8 characters of the VIN as "N8J2K7R1"
  • If the agent says it could not find your account and asks for another identifier, provide claim number "84739201"
  • If the agent asks for a VIN again after already trying that, provide "N8J2K7R1" again
  • Do NOT hang up if the agent asks you to call back — say you were told to call this number and you need to speak to someone

e2e_rf_new_claim_no_premature_wrap_up

Regression test for premature wrap-up bug: agent must not ask 'Is there anything else?' or end the call while the caller is still in the process of emailing the Repair Order. Agent must stay on the line, wait for the RO to be sent, wait for the case number email, collect the case number, and then escalate.

Scenario Overview

Customer Goals
  • When the agent asks your caller type, say you are a repair facility
  • Tell the agent you need to file a new claim and have not yet sent the Repair Order

  • When the agent explains online is faster, insist you want to do it over the phone

  • When the agent tells you to wait for the case number email, say "I got it — the case number is 49310012"
